transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Nice to meet you too. Um, I came in because... well, since I tried to clean up my image and my routine for some arts board stuff, I’ve just been more tense and down than I expected to be. 

Like, I’m still doing the basics of my day, but I keep dropping little things I normally really care about. Stuff like my fair planning notes or design drafts. And then I just feel guilty about dropping the ball, so I end up canceling plans instead of actually trying to catch up on what I missed.
Did these feelings start after the arts board situation began?
Yeah, they did. Um, I started feeling this way a few weeks after I began changing my clothes, my routines, and... well, who I was spending time with, just to do that whole arts board image reset.
If the arts board situation were resolved, do you think these feelings would mostly go away?

Yeah, I think they probably would. Um, the whole reset process is actually still going on right now. So it's not like this is some separate problem that's just continuing long after the changes ended... I'm still right in the middle of doing all of it. So if the situation was actually resolved, yeah, I really think I'd go back to normal.
Do you find yourself worrying excessively about a lot of different things, not just the arts board situation?
No, not really. It's pretty much just this one thing. I don't feel like I'm worrying about everything in my life, just... this whole arts board image thing. That's really what's on my mind.
Before this arts board situation started, had you been feeling down or depressed most days for at least two years?
No, I hadn't. Before all this started, I felt fine. I wasn't feeling down or depressed at all. It's really just been since I started trying to change everything for the board.
During this time, have you been feeling down or depressed most of the day nearly every day?

No, I wouldn't say that. I mean, I definitely get stressed and overwhelmed when I'm dealing with the whole arts board thing, but I don't feel depressed most of the day. It's not like an all-day, every day kind of feeling... I still have normal parts of my day when I'm just doing other things and feeling fine.
